dialogues.speaker: Rather Aged Notes
dialogues.text: (These notes seem to have been plundered during a recent raid on the Fatui. The age of these notes has made the words difficult to recognize.)

dialogues.speaker: Rather Aged Notes
dialogues.text: "...We at last made a single nagamaki. We call it the 'Daitatara Nagamasa'..."

dialogues.speaker: Rather Aged Notes
dialogues.text: "The Inspector was in high spirits, and he and the Vice Armory Officer..."

dialogues.speaker: Rather Aged Notes
dialogues.text: "...Nozomu was so taken by the beauty of the Daitatara Nagamasa that he drew a picture of it..."

dialogues.speaker: Rather Aged Notes
dialogues.text: "...and he performed a sword dance with that wandering eccentric..."
